Contact

Contact Loft Conversions London

Tell us a little about your home and we will arrange a free, no-obligation loft survey anywhere in London. You will get honest advice on what your loft can become and a fixed written quote.

  • Email: info@loftconversionslondon.co.uk
  • Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm
  • Area: all 32 London boroughs

Request Your Free Survey

No obligation. We call you back within one working day.

What happens next

What Happens After You Get in Touch

  1. We call you back to understand your home and what you want from the loft.
  2. We book a free survey at a time that suits you.
  3. We visit, measure the loft, check the roof and talk through options.
  4. You receive a fixed written quote, with no obligation to go ahead.

Not sure which type of conversion you need? Read about dormer, hip-to-gable and mansard loft conversions, or just tick "Not sure yet" on the form.
